summary.en: USB/IP client and driver for Windows; the 0.9.8.1 release ships an arm64 installer.
summary.zh-TW: Windows 版 USB/IP 用戶端與驅動程式；0.9.8.1 版提供 arm64 安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Installs a kernel driver; only the installer architecture in the winget manifest was confirmed and the driver's runtime behavior is untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 會安裝核心驅動程式；只確認 winget 資訊清單中的安裝檔架構，驅動程式執行行為尚未驗證。
